sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda announces Lambda Web Functions, a new serverless compute primitive where your code handles HTTP requests directly. Your code listens on a port and handles requests as it would on any HTTP server.

items.title: Muse Spark Open model now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.blurb: Meta's Muse Spark Open is now available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding the portfolio of foundation models available to AWS customers.

items.title: Libreboot 26.10 "Ominous Olive" released with UEFI, Chromebook support
Simons Foundation launches $15M effort to help mathematicians navigate AI era
Amazon CloudWatch log centralization now available in AWS GovCloud and additional commercial Regions
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch log centralization is now available in AWS GovCloud (US) and 13 additional commercial Regions.

items.title: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: AWS Lambda durable functions are now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) and AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions.

items.title: Zod Brings In-Process Schema Compilation and a 9x Cut in Memory Footprint
items.blurb: Zod is a TypeScript-focused schema validation library that recently released versions 4.5 and 4.6. Key updates include schema compilation for faster data parsing, significant memory usage reductions, and new validation features.

items.title: Helidon 27 Introduces Restructured Programming Models and New Messaging and Data Modules
items.blurb: The release of Helidon 27 is the first release that follows the Oracle Tip & Tail Model of Library Development by which the Tip adopts the latest Java technology while the Tail provides a more stable and secure baseline.
